markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (95%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds Normal only, and the second model agrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 95%, Benign 4%, InSitu <1% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.00 percentile | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Normal [F5] | Mostly concordant |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score; lowers concept-model invasive association [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Below typical, but spot check 0/20; disregard · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score; spot check only 12/20 · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Near-typical score; small effect · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses, the second-largest term here, is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Region 10 scores 96% invasive on the per-region probe layer, against <1% overall.
- Image is simulated and resample-degraded (severity 3); reliability error AUROC is only 0.69.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 10**: per-region probe scores 96% invasive; confirm no stromal invasion or necrosis.
2. **Region 6**: per-region probe scores 53% invasive; confirm benign architecture.
3. **Region 5**: check whether atypical cells are truly duct-confined (spot check 12/20).
